title: Lovely Juicy Japanese Pork Katsudon
description: A savory and juicy Japanese dish featuring pork, oregano, and a mortar-pestle pound, served over rice in a paella pan, friendly to ayurvedic tamasic diets.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a paella pan over medium high heat.
Pound the chopped oregano in a mortar and pestle to release its oils and flavor.
Dip each pork slice into the beaten egg and then coat with panko breadcrumbs mixed with the pounded oregano.
Fry the breaded pork slices in the paella pan until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the pork from the pan and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pan and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, and sake to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir fry until the rice is well coated with the sauce and heated through.
Return the pork to the pan and stir to combine with the rice and sauce.
Serve the katsudon hot in the paella pan.
